hungary.title: Flag of Hungary
desc: - Three equal horizontal stripes of red, white, and green, originating from the 1848 Hungarian Revolution
- The tricolour represents strength, faithfulness, and hope for the Hungarian nation
trivia:
- The red, white, and green have represented Hungary since the 13th century
- The coat of arms shows a crown with a cross, referencing the Holy Crown of Hungary (St. Stephen's Crown)
- Hungary's flag is one of the oldest European symbols, predating most modern nation-states
